fields.key: stable identifier used in URL hashes and tests
fields.label: human-readable display name
fields.params_b_total: Total parameter count in billions. Drives weight memory budgeting (weightsBytes) — for MoE, all experts must sit in HBM. For dense models, equals params_b_active.
fields.params_b_active: Parameters that actually execute per token, in billions. Drives compute roofline (2BN/FLOPs in stepTime). For dense models, equals params_b_total. For MoE, this is (shared experts) + k × (routed expert size).
fields.n_experts: MoE only: total routed experts (E). Omit for dense models.
fields.experts_per_token: MoE only: top-k routing (k). Omit for dense models.
fields.n_kv_heads: key/value head count (= n_heads for MHA, < for GQA, 1 for MQA)
fields.d_ff: FFW intermediate (up-projection) dimension. Used in Y_max = d_ff/(B·β). For SwiGLU models there are 3 FFW matrices but the constant cancels in Y_max.
fields.attn_type: MHA | GQA | MLA — KV per-token formula differs for MLA
fields.kv_lora_rank: MLA latent dim (d_c). Required when attn_type=MLA; omitted otherwise.
fields.qk_rope_head_dim: MLA rope key dim (d_rope). Required when attn_type=MLA; omitted otherwise.

models.label: Llama-3-8B
models.notes: Meta Llama-3 base. GQA 4:1 grouping. SwiGLU FFW with d_ff=14336 (HF config intermediate_size).

models.label: Llama-3-70B
models.notes: Reference worked example (§3, §5): KV/token int8 ≈ 160 kB; 32 batch × 8k ≈ 42 GB KV. SwiGLU FFW d_ff=28672.

models.label: Qwen2.5-7B
models.notes: Aggressive GQA 7:1; long context up to 128k with YaRN (use 32k default). SwiGLU FFW d_ff=18944.

models.label: Mistral-7B
models.notes: Mistral-7B-v0.3. Sliding-window attention not modelled — KV estimate is full-context upper bound. SwiGLU FFW d_ff=14336.

models.label: DeepSeek-V3 (671B MoE, 37B active)
models.notes: MoE: 671B total weights stream from HBM; 37B active per token drives compute. MLA cache: (512+64) × bytes × 61 layers per token. Reference §3 table + §7.
